# Ignis Leadership

> Connecting Energy is an Ignis Leadership publication by Yorik Tisseau about the commercial decisions shaping Britain’s and Europe’s energy system.

- [Insights](https://www.ignisleadership.com/insights) – latest Substack previews and free Signal archive
- [Connecting Energy Podcast](https://www.ignisleadership.com/podcast) – episodes and guest enquiries
- [Live events](https://www.ignisleadership.com/events) – audience debates on energy
- [Energy map](https://www.ignisleadership.com/map) – forthcoming free map of Britain’s energy system
- [Research and guides](https://www.ignisleadership.com/resources) – free energy research
- [Work with Yorik Tisseau](https://www.ignisleadership.com/work-with-me) – speaking and advisory
